leo (partnerships): Heads-up: SPN-Delta EAP confirmed for next Tue. NDA countersigned. Partner wants a short runbook + artifact handoff flow.
sara (eng-infra): Got it. do we have image sha + kernel tag? prefer S3 presigned uploads or SFTP fallback.
leo (partnerships): image tar sha256:a1b2... kernel tag v5.14-hyp. They prefer presigned S3.
carmen (solutions): Runbook outline: smoke -> latency (seq256 p50/p95) -> throughput (batch 1..16) -> 10-sample E2E -> quick quality eval. each step <12m.
ben (ml): i'll run 30 compliance prompts + 20 functional, seed=42, output CSV with perplexity and length.
adele (legal): embargo on publication until joint release. can provide a neutral status line only.
deploy-bot: INF-6799 created by sara at 1743216900. ETA ~20h for cross-account S3.
sara (eng-infra): if INF-6799 not ready we'll use SFTP. will push repo infra/bench/spn-delta and open PR.
carmen (solutions): add quantization decision table: prefer int8 q8_0, fallback fp16 if token-logprob delta > threshold.
leo (partnerships): partner requested preliminary notes within 48h of the window. we should aim to deliver internal slide.
sara (eng-infra): telemetry: p50/p95 latency, peak GPU mem, host CPU%. detailed traces off by default.
ben (ml): timeline: runbook + scripts by EOD, bench Tue 09:00-11:30 PT, internal slide Wed AM.
carmen (solutions): draft neutral line: "Initial internal validation runs scheduled with SPN-Delta hardware; results under embargo pending joint review."
adele (legal): approved to send to partner.
leo (partnerships): thanks. i'll confirm schedule with partner and post updates here once INF-6799 completes. :white_check_mark:
